item.title: Harbor council approves new ferry terminal
item.description: Short summary of the ferry decision.
item.content:encoded:
The Harbor council voted 7 to 2 on Monday to approve a new ferry terminal.

Construction is expected to begin in spring.

item.title: Lighthouse museum names new director
item.description: Marta Okafor has been named director of the Lighthouse Museum, replacing Ingrid Solberg.

item.title: Fish market moves to Pier 4
item.description: The weekly fish market relocates to Pier 4 starting next week.
